description: This PHP source file defines a REST API endpoint class 'CleanUpInstallAPI' for handling cleanup operations during the installation process of the OrangeHRM HR management system. It extends an abstract REST controller and manages cleanup based on the database type stored in the application's state.

classes.name: CleanUpInstallAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller that performs cleanup operations during the installation process, specifically handling database cleanup or reset based on installation state.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to the API endpoint, performing cleanup operations such as dropping the database or cleaning up after a failed installation, depending on the database type.
